title: More crash retrievals in the ocean than elsewhere
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of More crash retrievals in the ocean than elsewhere, about unspecified at Oceans, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: by the way, Eric Davis has said there are more crash retrieval operations that have been occurred in the ocean than elsewhere.

plain: A retired US Navy admiral, Tim Gallaudet, passes on a claim from a man named Eric Davis. According to Gallaudet, Davis has said that more crash retrievals, meaning operations to recover crashed unknown craft, have happened in the ocean than anywhere else. If true, it would mean the sea is where most such secret recoveries take place.
